title: Polyhydroxyalkanoates as multifaceted biopolymers: an eco-friendly alternative to conventional plastics
content:

Polyhydroxyalkanotes (PHAs) are biodegradable biopolymers produced through microbial synthesis, offering a sustainable alternative to conventional plastics with versatile properties and applications in agriculture, medicine and healthcare.
